review: Codex visual collation, 2026-10-19. Selected public-domain passages, punctuation added; ellipsis marks omitted text. Not expert approval.

sections.text: 甲己相合之始則化為土，土生金故乙庚化金次之，金生水故丙辛化水又次之，水生木故丁壬化木又次之。
sections.usage: Traditional pair/result nomenclature only; no automatic conversion of chart elements.

sections.text: 如甲與己合，而甲己中間以庚隔之，則甲豈能越尅我之庚而合己。
sections.usage: Observe intervening controlling stems. Do not generalize this example into a complete binary 合化 algorithm.

sections.text: 又如隔位太遠，如甲在年干，己在時上。
sections.usage: Record actual position gap. Do not turn the source's qualitative fraction into a numeric score.

sections.text: 又有合而不以合論者，本身之合也。
sections.usage: Record whether day stem participates; do not infer 合去 or relationship outcomes.

sections.text: 又有爭合妒合之說，如兩辛合丙、兩丁合壬之類。若以兩合一而隔位，全無爭妒，如庚午、乙酉、甲子、乙亥，兩乙合庚，甲日隔之。
sections.usage: Keep partner positions and adjacency. Multiple pair matches alone do not establish 爭合.

sections.heading: 論十干有得時不旺失時不弱
sections.text: 故八字雖以月令為重……不可執一論也。
sections.usage: Do not classify whole-chart strength from month alone.

sections.text: 是故日干不論月令休囚，只要四柱有根。干多不如根重，理固然也。
sections.usage: Record same-stem/same-element hidden-stem evidence only. Root grades, weights, strength and all traditional root conventions remain outside this detector.

sections.text: 又有刑沖而會合不能解者。
sections.usage: Keep coexisting pairs. No universal rule that combinations cancel clashes.

sections.heading: 論用神
sections.text: 八字用神，專求月令，以日干配月令地支，而生尅不同，格局分焉。
sections.usage: Keep month context; do not silently equate this book's 用神 with a modern favorable-element selector.

sections.heading: 論用神變化
sections.text: 用神既主月令矣，然月令所藏不一，而用神遂有變化。假使寅月為提，不透甲而透丙。
sections.usage: Observe exact monthly hidden stems visible in year/month/hour stems. The day stem is the reference, not counted as an additional exposed use-god.

sections.text: 如十二支中，除子午卯酉外，餘皆有藏。
sections.usage: This discussion groups 子午卯酉 together; do not use it to overwrite the other source's explicit 午宮丁火並己土 hidden-stem list. Do not claim the two texts provide identical complete lists.
